name: new-hire-onboarding
description: Get a new hire's first day and first 90 days right from one JSON file per hire. Three deterministic stdlib scripts: a preboarding gate that dates every task (contract, laptop, accounts, payroll, day-one agenda) against the start date in business days, applies the US I-9 and UK right-to-work deadlines and refuses a start with no named manager or buddy; a 30/60/90 plan builder that refuses milestones nobody could check and books day-30/60/90 checkpoints and weekly buddy meetings; and a ramp check that finds missed checkpoints, overdue milestones and a lapsed buddy without ever judging probation. Ships cs-onboarding-lead agent, /cs-preboarding-check, /cs-onboarding-plan and /cs-ramp-check commands and 3 cited references.
